- **summary** — Scaffold a configurable dev/main branching, auto-merge, branch-cleanup, and release-tagging workflow into any repo. ## Troubleshooting

- never mutates repo state directly — The deterministic/nondeterministic split is load-bearing: the agent decides, the CLI does. Losing this line reopens ad-hoc direct gh/git calls from the agent. `skills/shipflow/skills/shipflow/skill-invariants.json:6`
- Wait for explicit confirmation before proceeding — A plan must be shown and confirmed before any real apply — this is the safety property the whole design rests on. `skills/shipflow/skills/shipflow/skill-invariants.json:11`
- Do NOT silently pick either value — The round-2 false-positive fix: ambiguous branch protection must be explicitly disambiguated with the user, never silently defaulted, or protection ends up un-audi… `skills/shipflow/skills/shipflow/skill-invariants.json:16`
- refuses to wire up auto-merge with zero required checks — The fail-open guard: an empty requiredChecks list must never silently enable an unprotected auto-merge. `skills/shipflow/skills/shipflow/skill-invariants.json:21`
- Never silently pass --force — A hand-edited template file must always be surfaced and explicitly confirmed per entry, never auto-overridden. `skills/shipflow/skills/shipflow/skill-invariants.json:26`
